meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解方案或讨论为带依赖的任务单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常把方案或讨论纪要变成任务清单
copy.tagline_en: Turn plans and specs into dependency-aware tickets automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn plans or specs into actionable task lists.

howto.what: 把计划、规格或当前对话拆成一组「追踪弹」纵向切片工单,每张标明被哪些工单阻塞,再按配置的追踪器发布:本地每张一个文件,或真实追踪器上的原生阻塞链接。发布前会先把拆分方案列给你确认。
howto.when: 需要手动调用(已关闭模型自动触发)。当你想把计划、规格或当前对话拆成工单时使用;可传入规格路径、issue 编号或 URL 等引用作为参数。

say.note: 它会先看代码库,再把拆分列表给你确认

say.text: 读一下 issue 123,按它拆出追踪弹工单
say.note: 会抓取该 issue 的正文和评论作为依据

say.text: 这个粒度太粗了,帮我拆细一点
say.note: 它会按你的反馈迭代拆分再发布

howto.what_en: Turns a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each listing the tickets that block it, then publishes them to the configured tracker — one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links.
howto.when_en: Manual only — auto-invocation is off. Use it when splitting a plan, spec, or the current conversation into tickets; pass a spec path or issue number as an argument.

say_en.note: It explores the codebase, then quizzes you on the breakdown.

say_en.text: Read issue #123 and break it into tracer-bullet tickets.
say_en.note: It fetches that issue's body and comments first.

say_en.text: This granularity is too coarse — split the tickets finer.
say_en.note: It iterates on the breakdown before publishing.
